title: Query Performance
intro: Applies to: Eloquent and query-builder queries, list and report endpoints, eager loading, model `$with` declarations.

Lane boundaries: starting queries from `Model::query()` (not `DB::`) and eager-loading what you iterate are owned by `models-domain.md`; this file adds query-shape rules on top of them. Profiling and hunting slow paths that no written rule names stays with `/code-review`.

entries.rule: Queries **MUST NOT** load a whole table and filter it in PHP (`all()->filter()`, `get()->where()`); the condition **MUST** go into the query. The database filters with indexes and returns only the rows needed; PHP filtering loads every row first.
entries.why: The database filters with indexes and returns only the rows needed; PHP filtering loads every row first

entries.rule: Filtering on a relation **SHOULD** use `whereHas()`/`withCount()` so the database decides; eager-loading every related row to filter in PHP **SHOULD NOT** be used. This does not contradict "eager-load what you iterate" (`models-domain.md`): that rule is about rows you iterate, this one is about rows you only filter on.
entries.lane_note: starting queries from `Model::query()` (not `DB::`) and eager-loading what you iterate are owned by `models-domain.md`; this file adds query-shape rules on top of them. Profiling and hunting slow paths that no written rule names stays with `/code-review`.

entries.rule: Models **MUST NOT** declare a `$with` property; relations **MUST** be eager-loaded per query. A `$with` default loads relations on every query, including the ones that never read them.
entries.why: A `$with` default loads relations on every query, including the ones that never read them

checks.coverage: Flags a $with property declared on an Eloquent Model subclass.

entries.rule: A trimmed `select()` **MUST** include the keys every eager-loaded relation needs (parent foreign key, related id in `relation:columns`). A missing key hides as a null relation, not as an error.
entries.why: A missing key hides as a null relation, not as an error

entries.rule: List and report queries **SHOULD** select only the columns they use instead of `SELECT *`.

Aggregate reports **SHOULD** be one grouped query that starts from `Model::query()` and drops to the base builder with `toBase()`, never a PHP loop over models. This keeps the `models-domain.md` rule that queries start from `Model::query()`.
